svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.2k stars in total, about 1.07k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 444, aube 2026, fnox 2219, hk 1229, pitchfork 676, usage 1050, +5 more 558.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
